lines.beaver: 어서 오세요. 해님 빵집이에요. 뭘 도와드릴까요?
lines.beaver_en: Welcome. This is Haenim Bakery. How can I help?
lines.beaver_roman: eoseo oseyo. haenim ppangjibieyo. mwol dowadeurilkkayo?
lines.en: I bought a cake at this bakery yesterday.

lines.beaver_en: Yes, is there a problem with the cake?
lines.en: I got the same cake again as a gift.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, so you'd like to exchange it?
lines.learner: 네, 다른 상품으로 바꿀 수 있어요?
lines.en: Yes, can I exchange it for another product?
lines.roman: ne, dareun sangpumeuro bakkul su isseoyo?

lines.beaver_en: Of course. Do you have the receipt?
lines.learner: 네, 여기 영수증이에요. 포장도 안 열었어요.
lines.en: Yes, here's the receipt. I didn't open the packaging.
lines.roman: ne, yeogi yeongsujeungieyo. pojangdo an yeoreosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 그럼 다른 빵으로 바꿔 드릴게요.
lines.beaver_en: Good. Then I'll exchange it for other bread.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. geureom dareun ppangeuro bakkwo deurilgeyo.
lines.en: Is the exchange free of charge?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, it's free if it's the same price.
lines.en: What's that black bread over there?

lines.beaver_en: It's chocolate bread. It's rich and sweet.
lines.en: Great. By the way, do you send parcels too?

lines.beaver_en: Sure. These days we do parcel delivery too.
lines.en: I'd like to send bread to my grandma.

lines.beaver_en: If sent today, it arrives tomorrow.
lines.learner: 그럼 이 초코빵을 택배로 보내 주세요.
lines.en: Then please send this chocolate bread by parcel.
lines.roman: geureom i chokoppangeul taekbaero bonae juseyo.

lines.beaver: 네. 오늘은 빵 하나 서비스로 더 드릴게요.
lines.beaver_en: Okay. Today I'll give you one extra bread for free.
lines.beaver_roman: ne. oneureun ppang hana sseobisseuro deo deurilgeyo.
lines.learner: 고마워요! 이 빵집에 자주 오게 될 것 같아요.
lines.en: Thank you! I think I'll end up coming here often.
lines.roman: gomawoyo! i ppangjibe jaju oge doel geot gatayo.
